summary: Skratch showcases an updated high-performing Thunderbolt team lineup for the Continental Challenge boss Talethia in Season 8. The setup achieves over 851 million damage on a 15-second skill timing rotation without high hero inspiration levels. Key build details include stacking extreme Skill Haste on Phaessa, using Journ for ultimate energy generation, and equipping Alaura with Dawn Pipe Organ to heavily buff Perkunte's damage output. Substitutions for missing heroes such as Nissa for Tariz are also explained.

heroes.name: Perkunte
heroes.note: Primary damage dealer in the Thunderbolt team, dealing over 780 million damage individually on Talethia.

heroes.name: Phaessa
heroes.note: Requires high Skill Haste and Enlightenment to rotate healing fast enough to keep the entire team alive.

heroes.name: Journ
heroes.note: Provides rapid ultimate energy generation and attack buffs to maintain a strict 15-second team skill cycle.

heroes.name: Alaura
heroes.note: Using Dawn Pipe Organ instead of her exclusive artifact allows her to heavily amplify Perkunte's damage output.

heroes.name: Tariz
heroes.note: Applies consistent Defense Down while taking front-row position; can be replaced by Nissa.

heroes.name: Nissa
heroes.note: Serves as the best alternative to Tariz for applying Defense Down in Thunderbolt boss setups.

heroes.name: Rena
heroes.note: Can replace Phaessa as the primary team healer/support if unavailable.

teams.note: High-performing Thunderbolt team hitting 851M+ damage on Talethia using a 15-second recast cycle and Dawn Pipe Organ buffing.

meta_changes: Thunderbolt compositions scale exceptionally well in Continental Challenge boss fights by combining fast energy battery cycles with high Skill Haste supports.
tips: Equip Alaura with the Dawn Pipe Organ artifact rather than her exclusive artifact to maximize attack buffs on Perkunte.
Prioritize maximum Skill Haste and Enlightenment on Phaessa to rotate her battle skill healing rapidly.
Set ultimate timing on a 15-second recast cycle to synchronize energy generation with damage windows.
Ensure heroes are positioned in a straight line relative to Journ so everyone receives ultimate energy.
title: Updated Thunderbolt Team Vs Boss Challenge Talethia! Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
